title: What makes a trade-show supplier brief effective?
body: A good brief reduces the number of assumptions everyone has to make. Dates, access, compatibility and contingency deserve attention before any quotation.

title: The hidden work behind international events
body: A client sees the event. Behind it are teams, suppliers, transport, site restrictions, quotations and dozens of decisions that need one clear owner.

title: Sourcing in China: the questions worth asking first
body: Before looking for a manufacturer, define requirements, quantity, acceptable alternatives, samples, commercial terms and quality controls.

title: How to compare two supplier quotations
body: The lowest figure on a quote is rarely the full project cost. Compare delivery, staffing, setup, technical assurances and what is excluded.
